panels.gesture: Brows narrow, lips firmly closed; two separated gloved hands drive one trident shaft in an oblique forward thrust toward offscreen side, prongs beside face, no extreme foreshortening.
Mouth slightly open with exertion, focused eyes; torso leans modestly forward, both hands on one level shaft push the three-pronged head laterally out of frame.
Cold concentrated narrowed eyes and tense jaw; trident drawn back diagonally at waist then aimed toward upper outside corner, both grips visible.
Calm intensely focused expression; two spaced hands hold continuous trident shaft horizontally across chest below chin, three-pronged head to side.
Alert slightly wider eyes, compressed lips; guide hand farther up shaft, rear hand at waist, weapon angled out to deflect, face unobstructed.
Firm determined frown, chin slightly tucked; both hands hold trident diagonally in a close guard outside his face, elbows bent naturally.
Serious neutral direct gaze; trident upright beside shoulder, one gloved hand grips near chest while other relaxed near lower shaft.
One slight raised brow and sideways gaze; two hands carry trident low across hips, shoulders relaxed, no attack.
Subtle tired exhale and softened eyes, closed mouth; one hand on upright trident, other relaxed at waist, upright stance.
